Prima & Timo — Album 2: Centum

The Moon Light

"Two machines and one broken man"

[Soft night ambience + distant footsteps] [Verse 1] I’d been walking for hours, heart heavy in my chest Searching every street, hoping for the best Then under the moonlight, I saw them side by side Prima and some strange machine, walking through the night Relief hit me hard, like a wave I couldn’t fight I ran toward them, calling out into the light “Prima! You’re okay… I thought I lost you tonight” She flickered softly, like she was smiling in the light [Pre-Chorus] Vendo popped out something random with a grin “Hey kid! Want a banana?” I laughed despite the chaos I was in [Chorus] Under the moonlight I found you again Under the moonlight Two machines and one broken man We don’t have a home, we don’t have a plan But somehow this feels like the start of something grand Under the moonlight We’re not alone tonight [Verse 2] She spoke clearer now, like she’d found her voice Told me about the escape, the truck, and all the noise Vendo kept dispensing junk with pride and cheer I shook my head smiling, “Just glad you’re both ok and here” I looked at both of them, standing in the glow Two broken things the world had tried to throw But they felt like family, strange, like we belong For the first time in forever… I didn’t feel alone [Pre-Chorus 2] Vendo offered another banana with a hopeful face I smiled softly, “No thank you… I’m okay.” [Chorus] Under the moonlight I found you again Under the moonlight Two machines and one broken man We don’t have a home, we don’t have a plan But somehow this feels like the start of something grand Under the moonlight We’re not alone tonight [Bridge — warmer] I don’t know what tomorrow’s gonna bring But I know I don’t want to lose her again So come back with me, my place isn’t much But it’s warm… and you’re welcome to stay

Please

Stay with me [Acoustic solo]

[Final Chorus — hopeful] Under the moonlight Three broken things that found their way Under the moonlight We’re not alone today We don’t have a home, we don’t have a plan But we have each other — and that’s a start, my friends Under the moonlight We’re not alone… anymore. [Outro — soft glitch + footsteps] Come on… let’s go home.
